race.description: Buy Your Kosciuszko Tickets At Tab Highway Hcp (C2)
race.comment: ZALIQUE (6) has come back flying with two good wins and even from the wide draw his profile is hard to ignore. LOVECATS (13) keeps spotting big starts but she hits the line with purpose and the rise in trip on the quick back up looks ideal. ZOU FORCE (7) strips fitter second up and Clark should spear across to have him handy. With natural improvement he can fight out the finish. XTREME (5) just missed here fresh and with a good draw and natural improvement he stays right in the mix. GIDDY UP GRIFF (8) has made it back-to-back wins to kick off this prep and the form around him is stacking right up. Drawn cosy and deserves his chance.
